detail.title: Execution Detail
detail.load_failed: Failed to load the requested execution

lineage.title: Inputs and Outputs
lineage.description: Resources actually read and results produced by this execution

recovery_circuit_open.title: Automatic Recovery Circuit Open
recovery_circuit_open.description: Recovery has failed {failures} consecutive times. The next probe is allowed at {nextAttempt}; no valid runtime session is active.

recovery_half_open.title: Recovery Probe In Progress
recovery_half_open.description: The circuit cooldown has elapsed and the current session is verifying whether the data path can recover stably.

recovery_waiting.title: Waiting for Automatic Recovery
recovery_waiting.description: Recovery has failed {failures} consecutive times. The next attempt is allowed at {nextAttempt}.

recovery_ready.title: Waiting for Worker Claim
recovery_ready.description: The recovery backoff has elapsed and the execution is waiting for an available continuous worker.

retention_critical.title: Continuous Recovery Window Critical
retention_critical.description: The committed position may be outside source retention, or the remaining recovery horizon is below the critical threshold.

retention_degraded.title: Continuous Recovery Window at Risk
retention_degraded.description: At the current source growth rate, the estimated recovery horizon is below the degraded threshold.

checkpoint_stalled.title: Target Commit Has Stalled
checkpoint_stalled.description: Source lag remains and the real position commit has not advanced for more than {threshold}.

diagnostics_error.title: Continuous Diagnostics Failed
diagnostics_error.description: Transfer could not complete the latest diagnostics sample: {error}

source_recovery_critical.title: Source Log Recovery Window Lost
source_recovery_critical.description: The capture position is older than the source database's available log boundary, so this capture generation cannot resume continuously from its current position.

source_recovery_unavailable.title: Source Log Recovery Window Unavailable
source_recovery_unavailable.description: Transfer currently lacks the complete facts required to assess the source log recovery window. This does not mean the source is offline.

source_transactions_unavailable.title: Source Transaction Pressure Unavailable
source_transactions_unavailable.description: Transfer cannot currently observe uncommitted transaction pressure. Source recovery and source connectivity remain independent facts.

schema_change_blocked.title: Database Schema Change Blocked Sync
schema_change_blocked.description: The source table schema changed, so the current message and committed position remain unchanged. Approve eligible added fields in the Transfer task, or stop and recreate the task.

detail.open_task_unavailable: No task definition entry is available for this execution

alert.title: Alert Incidents

validation.name: Enter a webhook name
validation.secret: The signing secret must be at least 16 bytes

delivery.title: Delivery Records
delivery.retry_confirm: Retry with the destination's current endpoint and signing secret while reusing the original delivery ID? The receiver may process the message again.

targets.endpointHint: HTTPS URL with an explicit port and /metrics path
targets.configHint: Enabled means collection is configured; resource observations show actual collection.
targets.accessDenied: This identity cannot view platform monitoring targets
targets.loadFailed: Unable to load monitoring targets. Please retry.
targets.conflict: Configuration has changed. Your draft is retained; reload before trying again.
targets.invalidForm: Select a host and enter a valid collection address

collection.title: Latest collection result
collection.savedConfig: These results belong to the saved settings; the draft has not taken effect.
collection.denied: You do not have permission to view collection results.
collection.unsupported: Collection results are not yet available for container resource targets.
collection.disabled: The saved collection settings are disabled.
collection.changed: The settings have changed and these results cannot be matched. Reload the settings.
collection.metricHint: A successful scrape does not mean every metric has data. Check individual metrics in Host monitoring.

collection.not_connected: Host collection is not enabled. Configure a collection source.
collection.no_sample: Waiting for collection evidence. Check whether settings have taken effect.
collection.failed: Collection failed. Check the collection address, network and certificates. Missing values do not mean zero load.
collection.stale: Collection evidence has expired. Current data cannot indicate real-time status.
collection.waiting: The latest collection succeeded. Some metrics do not yet have valid samples or a complete measurement window.

resources.title: Host monitoring
resources.refreshStopped: Auto refresh stopped; reload to retry
resources.gaps: Stale, missing and disconnected points appear as gaps.
resources.cpuBusyHint: Average non-idle time across cores over the last minute, including I/O wait and steal time; incomplete windows show no data.

errors.unconfigured: Resource observations are not fully configured.
errors.unavailable: Unable to read resource observations. Refresh later.
errors.timeout: Resource query timed out. Refresh later.
errors.budget: The query exceeds the current budget. Select a shorter range or contact an administrator.
errors.busy: The resource query concurrency limit has been reached. Refresh later.
errors.notFound: This host does not exist or is currently inaccessible.
errors.denied: Your current identity cannot view platform host resources.
errors.invalidResponse: The resource response is incomplete. Refresh to try again.
errors.invalidDimensions: Invalid resource dimensions. Return to the host list to select a resource.

filesystem.title: Filesystem mounts
filesystem.hint: Capacity by mount. Bind mounts, memory and network filesystems are not summed as physical capacity.
filesystem.empty: Filesystem collection succeeded, but no usable mount data is available.
filesystem.notCollected: The current source does not provide filesystem metrics.
filesystem.collectorFailed: Filesystem collection failed. Check source permissions and runtime status.
filesystem.unknown: No filesystem data. Collection coverage has not been confirmed.

resources.loadSummary: Average number of running or waiting tasks, not a percentage.
resources.loadHint: Tasks are processes or threads that are running, waiting for CPU, or in uninterruptible wait (often I/O). The 1, 5 and 15 minute values are smoothed averages, so decimals are normal. Interpret them alongside CPU utilization; dividing by core count does not give CPU utilization.

disk.title: Disk IO
disk.orderHint: Devices with IO activity appear first; idle devices are collapsed by default. Missing or stale data remains visible.
disk.allIdle: No devices currently have IO activity. Expand to view all devices.

diskRead.detail: Average data read per second over the last complete minute, per device. Devices are not summed; incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskWrite.detail: Average data written per second over the last complete minute, per device. Devices are not summed; incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskBusy.detail: Percentage of the last complete minute during which the device had IO requests in progress. This alone does not prove saturation; interpret it alongside throughput and duration. Incomplete windows or counter resets remain missing.

diskReadDuration.detail: Average time per completed read request over the last complete minute, including queueing and processing. No completed reads, incomplete windows or counter resets display “—”, not 0 ms.

diskWriteDuration.detail: Average time per completed write request over the last complete minute, including queueing and processing. No completed writes, incomplete windows or counter resets display “—”, not 0 ms.

disk.empty: No disk throughput data. A continuous one-minute counter window is required. Check for interrupted collection, missing samples or counter reset.
disk.unknown: No disk throughput data. The cause is unconfirmed; check disk collection and a continuous one-minute counter window.

network.title: Network interface throughput
network.hint: Average receive and transmit rates over a full minute, per interface. Bridges, virtual and loopback interfaces are not summed; rates do not indicate link utilization.
network.empty: No network throughput data. Interface collection succeeded, but no valid rate samples are available. A continuous one-minute counter window is required; missing samples, reboot or counter reset can also prevent calculation.
network.notCollected: The current source does not provide network interface metrics. Waiting will not produce throughput data.
network.collectorFailed: Network interface collection failed. Check source permissions and runtime status.
network.unknown: No network throughput data. Interface collection coverage has not been confirmed.
